summary: Nice2Meechu auth refactor (phone-OTP → Emergent Google OAuth) fully verified. Backend pytest fixture updated to seed user + session directly into MongoDB (per /app/auth_testing.md) and use Bearer Authorization. 25/25 backend tests PASS, including new auth tests: GET / returns app='Nice2Meechu' & auth='google-emergent'; GET /api/auth/me without auth → 401; POST /api/auth/session with bogus session_id → 401 (provider rejects); GET /api/auth/me with seeded Bearer → 200; POST /api/auth/logout deletes session row → {ok:true}; all protected endpoints (users/me, onboarding, location, video, feed, swipe, matches, messages GET/POST) return 401 without auth. End-to-end Bearer flow: onboarding → location → video → feed (demo users seeded) → like → mutual match → /matches → POST/GET /messages with demo auto-reply → all green. Translation EN→ES works via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. Frontend at 480x900: (1) signin-screen + signin-google-button render; clicking sets window.location.href to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fhyperlocal-video.preview.emergentagent.com%2F (verified actual URL). (2) Visiting #session_id=bogus shows auth-callback-screen, posts to /api/auth/session, gets 401, falls back to signin. (3) Cookie-injection (session_token, httpOnly, secure, SameSite=None on app host) lands the seeded user on onboarding; full happy path traversed: handle 'pwtester' + 2 vibes + EN lang → video sample 0 → feed → 1 like triggered match celebration → 'Say hi' → chat screen → message sent → demo replied 'okay you have great taste' (2 messages, screenshot captured). (4) Logout (profile-logout) hits POST /api/auth/logout and returns user to signin-screen.
critical_code_review_comments: EMERGENT_AUTH_SESSION_URL is hardcoded constant — acceptable (it's Emergent platform URL, not a customer secret).
auth_logout returns {ok:true} even when no token present; consider 401 for clarity but not a bug.
Cookie set with samesite=None+secure requires HTTPS; works in preview env but a same-origin fallback for local dev is missing.
Recorded-video (mode=record) still stores blob: URLs in DB — won't render for the other user or after refresh; only sample-pick is durable. Carried over from prior iterations.
send_message has no rate-limit or text-length validation; demo auto-reply hardcoded list of 5 strings.
Chat bubble has data-testid=chat-msg-{id} (per-message) — verified 2 bubbles after send.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_n2m_backend.py (rewritten: auth fixture seeds user+session in mongo, removed all phone/OTP tests, added auth tests for new endpoints, expanded auth-guard parametrize to cover messages GET/POST)
test_credentials: No app-managed credentials. For tests: seed user+session in mongo (see /app/auth_testing.md). Example used this run: token=test_session_pw_1780010585953 → user-id=test-user-pw-1780010585953, onboarded as @pwtester.
seed_data_creation: Bypassed real Google OAuth by inserting a row into users + user_sessions collections directly (per playbook). Six demo users (luna/kai/rumi/sol/indie/noa) auto-seed on first /api/feed call; matched with @indie this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth has migrated from phone-OTP to Emergent Google OAuth. To test as an authenticated user without real Google: insert into db.users {id, email, handle:null, vibes:[], language:'en', avatar_emoji:'🌙'} and db.user_sessions {user_id, session_token, expires_at:7d, created_at}. Then either Authorization: Bearer <session_token> for API calls OR add Playwright cookie {name:'session_token', value:<token>, domain:'<app-host>', path:'/', httpOnly:true, secure:true, sameSite:'None'} for browser tests. Frontend viewport 480x900. Chat-screen intentionally does NOT render BottomNav (only feed/matches/profile do), so test nav clicks from one of those screens. App reads window.location.hash synchronously on mount to route AuthCallback before splash; do not regress this. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in backend/.env powers translation. Pytest cmd: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_n2m_backend.py -v.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Auth refactor verified clean. Previous iteration_1/2 fixes (chat-input z-40+pb-14, bottom-nav z-40+pb-10, WebM video fallback) all remain intact.
